images.title: A command lives beside the model
images.observation: Actual screen: Break Corner, despite the asset’s base-flange filename. Selected edges are listed in the left editor.
images.recommendation: Give each LemonCAD tool named selections, exact values, preview, Apply and Cancel.

images.title: Small tool set, clear starting point
images.observation: Simplified and default CommandManager layouts shown together.
images.recommendation: Start with common tools. Keep advanced commands accessible through search.

images.title: A workspace with distinct jobs
images.observation: Top: creation tools. Left: model structure. Canvas: view controls.
images.recommendation: Keep geometry commands separate from view controls; preserve room for the model.

images.title: A readable model tree
images.observation: Simplified tree on the left; default tree on the right.
images.recommendation: Show essentials first, with search and distinct feature states. Keep versions separate.

images.title: Commands follow the current task
images.observation: The sketch command strip includes dimensions, relations and extrusion.
images.recommendation: A Sketch context needs drawing and constraint tools, plus an obvious Finish action.

images.title: Simplicity is a workspace choice
images.observation: The View menu exposes the simplified workspace option.
images.recommendation: Keep a basic default and let experienced users reveal more tools without losing their model.

images.title: Parts belong to an assembly context
images.observation: A source washer and a larger assembly appear side by side.
images.recommendation: Make the selected component instance, its source part and intended mate explicit.

images.title: Reduce what the user must inspect
images.observation: Platform component selection appears beside the loaded desktop assembly.
images.recommendation: Plan isolate and component filtering before trying to display every part and panel.

images.title: Conversation can explain a failed feature
images.observation: A failure list, flagged feature tree and assistant share the screen.
images.recommendation: Link the explanation to the first failing feature and offer a specific repair.

images.title: A prompt leads to something reviewable
images.observation: The assembly structure is previewed before file generation.
images.recommendation: Review component hierarchy and scope before applying a conversational assembly change.

images.title: The browser product has its own layout
images.observation: xDesign places its Action Bar at the bottom of the browser workspace.
images.recommendation: Borrow browser-friendly access; choose LemonCAD’s tool placement based on our workflows.
